title: Human Intelligence Platform — Universal Human Life Domains
purpose: Define a universal life-domain ontology for future Human Digital Twin views and extensions.
design_thesis: One person manages one Human Digital Twin Core across multiple permissioned areas of life to support human flourishing and measurable progress.

human_digital_twin_core.identity: Persistent identity controlled by the person
human_digital_twin_core.events: Relevant events that update state, evidence and progress

universal_life_domains.name: Identity and Self
universal_life_domains.purpose: Understand identity, values, strengths, emotional context, self-knowledge and personal development.

universal_life_domains.name: Health and Vitality
universal_life_domains.purpose: Manage physical health, mental wellbeing, habits, energy, sleep, activity and vitality.

universal_life_domains.name: Learning and Capabilities
universal_life_domains.purpose: Develop knowledge, skills, credentials, competencies and learning goals.

universal_life_domains.name: Work and Contribution
universal_life_domains.purpose: Manage career, work, projects, experience, collaboration, productivity and contribution.

universal_life_domains.name: Relationships and Community
universal_life_domains.purpose: Support relationships, family, friendships, networks, belonging and community participation.

universal_life_domains.name: Resources and Material Security
universal_life_domains.purpose: Manage income, resources, financial security, material conditions and economic goals.

universal_life_domains.name: Purpose and Flourishing
universal_life_domains.purpose: Connect life goals, meaning, creativity, spirituality, civic impact, contribution and perceived progress.

interconnection_rules: All domains are permissioned views or extensions of one Human Digital Twin Core.
Domains must not create independent identities for the same person.
Cross-domain access is denied by default.
Cross-domain use requires identity, consent, purpose, minimum required data, authorized access and audit.
A capability or event may be referenced across domains without copying unrestricted source data.
The person remains in the decision loop for consequential recommendations or actions.
Sensitive and restricted data requires stronger authorization and narrower purpose.
The presence of a domain in this contract does not imply implementation or integration.

mvp_rule.rule: Implement one domain view at a time after problem and beachhead validation.
